patterns: APPSC asks AP institution identification: SERP full form and role, APMSS for rural and urban poor - recurring Group-2 items.
APPSC also asks headline numbers: rural poverty 2011-12 (25.7%), 90 million lifted out 2011-15, AP MPI trend.
Other PSCs ask which State has the most poor (UP) or highest ratio, and World Bank's four-State concentration (Bihar, UP, MP, Odisha).
Many PYQs filed here are demography/literacy strays, not poverty.
App MCQs match these well; they add AP district MPI figures and 2025-26 schemes (VB-G RAM G, graduation models).
